# Terms with nothing under them

`Glossary: gls-holl-empty-term` `DRAFT`

A glossary where two entries are a heading and no definition.

## Scope

This fixture only. It exists so `part-empty` is exercised where the part is a heading rather than a
table row. One entry holds a horizontal rule and the other an em dash, both standing in for the words,
since a check reading the rendered blocks would pass either.

## Terms

### Defined

A term carrying the one sentence its entry is for.
